recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Revisit only if a future work-group decision changes the TerminologyCapabilities maturity level or identifies a generated artifact that conflicts with the authoritative source.
issue_request: FHIR-31547 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocabulary technical correction reporting that TerminologyCapabilities showed FMM level 0 and should instead be FMM level 1. Its Jira resolution points to FHIR-28296.
initial_application: FHIR-28296 pre-applied the change in commit 21aa13610736c6883bfc980974ba5ae93f284ce6 by changing source/fhir.ini terminologycapabilities from 0 to 1. No separate source-changing commit was found for FHIR-31547 itself.
additional_context: FHIR-28296 is Published/Persuasive, Applied for Version R5, and records a 16-0-0 Vocabulary vote after FMG approval. January 2022 Vocabulary minutes list FHIR-31547 with FHIR-28296 as the TerminologyCapabilities maturity-level work, and January 2023 minutes record the FHIR-28296 acceptance. Zulip discussion also supports the rationale that validator and IG Publisher use justified raising TerminologyCapabilities from FMM 0 to at least 1.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active source/fhir.ini resource entry includes terminologycapabilities, the active [fmm] entry is terminologycapabilities=1, and the TerminologyCapabilities StructureDefinition also carries structuredefinition-fmm valueInteger value="1".
